about.heading: About GMF Str3tch
paragraphs: Known to the streets and the industry as GMF Productions, GMF Str3tch is a rising force in the rap scene. Representing the authentic sound of the Southside, his music delivers raw lyricism, undeniable grit, and story telling.
Built in Jacksonville, Florida, our mission is to inspire ambition, represent authenticity, and create timeless music and fashion that reflects the hustle behind every success.
